latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of browser-cli: Terminal-based Chrome browser automation via the AIPex extension.

- Control Chrome tabs, interact with page elements, fill forms, and capture screenshots entirely from the command line.
- Integrate browser automation with shell scripts, CI pipelines, and manual workflows — no MCP client required.
- Request human interventions during automation, download page content, and organize tabs with AI.
- CLI includes tab, page, interact, download, intervention, skill management, and standalone utility commands.
- Requires Node.js ≥18, AIPex Chrome extension, and a simple WebSocket setup.
